The '''Southside Prison''' was the main prison for in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was guarded by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and was only accessible through the air or a maglev tunnel.<ref name="CotG" />
